segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Yeah, thanks for making time, Karen. I pulled up the order form we discussed: 42 seats on the analytics package, annual term, starting March 1. I wanted to confirm the rollout dates and the billing contact before I send it over.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: That sounds right. We need 38 seats active at go-live and then 4 held for the finance team in April. Can the admin just assign those later, or do we need a separate amendment?

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: No separate amendment. The 42 are included from day one, and your admin can assign them whenever. Billing is still for all 42 seats for the annual term, though.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Okay, that’s fine. On the invoice, can you split the PO reference between operations and finance? Our AP team asked for cost center 7104 on 30 seats and 7109 on 12 seats.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Yes, we can put both cost centers in the billing notes. The invoice itself will be one invoice for $31,080 before tax, due net 30. If you need two separate invoices, that’s a different setup.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: One invoice is better. For timing, we want the kickoff the week of March 4, with training on March 12 if possible. Is that still open?

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: I checked with services this morning. March 12 at 1 p.m. Eastern is open for the main training, and they can do kickoff on March 5. The implementation package includes three working sessions, so that would be one of them.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Great. Legal already reviewed the MSA. They only flagged auto-renewal. We need 60 days’ notice instead of 30.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Yep, deal desk approved that change. The order form will show a 12-month initial term and 60-day non-renewal notice. No change to price.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Perfect. Send it to me and copy AP. If we can get the final order form today, I can route it for signature tomorrow.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Will do. I’ll send the order form in the next hour with the PO field left blank, and once you have the PO, you can reply with it or add it during signature.
